tests.name: every old task state becomes its assignment state, in its workspace's Inbox, with every record field, and the task views read the same task
tests.why: legacy fixture store with each old state; checks mapped state and the workspace Inbox; title echoes MUST 1's each-old-state and Inbox wording

tests.name: the move keeps a copy of the store from before it, holding every old task
tests.why: backup taken before the migration; title paraphrases the backup clause closely

tests.name: a move that fails half-way, after a row was written, is undone, the store still opens and says why, the readable tasks stay usable, and the next start moves them
tests.why: one-transaction rollback and host still starts saying why; title quotes MUST 1's half-way failure case

tests.name: a project belongs to one workspace and links a folder inside a knowledge repository; no folder yet is allowed and flagged; outside is refused with the reason
tests.why: title quotes MUST 2 and its no-folder and outside-folder cases

tests.name: an assignment moves from the Inbox to a project of its workspace and back, never to another workspace's or a missing project
tests.why: MUST 2 case: moving an assignment from the Inbox to a project; at most one project

tests.name: every old task state becomes its assignment state, in its workspace's Inbox, with every record field, and the task views read the same task
tests.why: asserts every new field with defaults on migrated rows and that the task view fields are unchanged

tests.name: a task whose check passes waits for the owner, and Merge brings it into the checkout's current branch
tests.why: existing, unchanged task test guarding the task's Merge path over the changed store

tests.name: Open a pull request: the task's agent drafts it, not a draft by default, and Create hands it to the opener
tests.why: existing, unchanged task test guarding Open pull request

tests.name: two updates from the same version: the first lands, the older one is refused
the task action route updates the record, refuses an older version with 409, and refuses bad fields
tests.why: version check through the HTTP route

tests.name: the task loop's own save keeps a move made since it read the task
tests.why: a stale internal save does not overwrite a newer write

tests: tests/unit/assignments.test.ts::every old task state becomes its assignment state, in its workspace's Inbox, with every record field, and the task views read the same task
findings.note: After the fix, Inboxes are created from sessions only, so a workspace stored only through a project before the change stays without an Inbox on reopen; the mapped migration test uses task-bearing fixtures only, and a base-failing test with a project-only fixture store would expose it.

tests: tests/unit/assignments.test.ts::every old task state becomes its assignment state, in its workspace's Inbox, with every record field, and the task views read the same task
findings.note: Inbox creation happened only inside the task migration loop, so workspaces with sessions but no tasks got none; the mapped test only uses stores with tasks, so a test opening a session-only fixture and listing projects would have failed at head.

tests: tests/unit/assignments.test.ts::a project belongs to one workspace and links a folder inside a knowledge repository; no folder yet is allowed and flagged; outside is refused with the reason
findings.note: Validation checked only lexical containment, so an existing file or a folder outside the projects area of a knowledge repository passed; the mapped test covers outside, parent-escape and root paths but not these, so adding those cases would expose it.

tests: tests/e2e/app.spec.ts::keeps every dialog inside a 720 px window, with its last button in reach when its content grows
findings.note: Gate-run finding: an unchanged Playwright test that starts and discards an assignment was left out of the browser regression selector; not a missing assertion, so no base-failing test applies, and it is outside the Vitest map.

notes: assignments.test.ts uses top-level test() calls with no describe, so names are bare titles. MUST 3's browser cases (task tab, Home rows) are checked only by Playwright tests in tests/e2e/app.spec.ts that existed at base; the map uses existing Vitest task-loop tests as PASS_TO_PASS guards instead. assignments.test.ts imports src/host/projects.ts, new on the branch, so base runs fail at import.
